content_blocks.label: clause_1._EXECUTION_AND_ACKNOWLEDGMENT
content_blocks.text: I, Elizabeth L. Hargrove, do hereby execute this Last Will and Testament and acknowledge that I have executed the same freely and voluntarily.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSITION_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: I direct that my personal property be distributed equally among my three children: John, Jane, and James Hargrove.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._GUARDIANSHIP
content_blocks.text: I appoint John Hargrove as the guardian of my minor grandchildren should I predecease them.
